findings: Garbage part rummage/scavenge/divination paths consume one stack object through RemoveOne and Destroy; they do not assign a replacement Render.Tile.
Native RandomTile builder owns four initial choices. The declared fallback is retained separately rather than counted as a fifth random choice.
BurnGenerateObjectInCell creates a separate native TrashFire-table object; no invented empty/burning Garbage art.
All four choices and fallback use the same fixed map view and native primary K channel; no directional or adjacency system is invented.
